# The Fresh Loaf

> > A community-driven bread baking resource featuring sourdough techniques, recipe conversions, and home baking troubleshooting.

The Fresh Loaf is a comprehensive bread baking community where home bakers share recipes, techniques, and experiences with sourdough starters, whole grain breads, and artisan baking methods. The site features contributions from experienced bakers discussing equipment like DLX and Bosch mixers, techniques from authorities like Dan Leader and Peter Reinhart, and detailed guides for fermentation and starter maintenance.

## Key Topics

- Sourdough starter maintenance and troubleshooting
- Whole wheat and rye bread baking
- Bread fermentation techniques
- Mixer comparisons (DLX, Bosch Universal, KitchenAid)
- Recipe conversion (bread machine to hand/mixer)
- Artisan bread methods (pain au levain, baguettes)
- Hamelman and Reinhart techniques
- Baking stone and oven management
- Yeast types (SAF instant, Red Star)
- Community bake events
- Detmolder and Vermont sourdough methods
- Bread troubleshooting (crust, crumb, starter issues)
- Wild yeast cultivation
- Specialty breads (kaiser rolls, pita, scones)
- Home baking equipment and tools

## Sourdough Techniques & Guides

- [Sourdough | The Fresh Loaf](https://www.thefreshloaf.com/handbook/sourdough): Comprehensive sourdough handbook covering fermentation and starter basics
- [trouble converting batter to firm starter | The Fresh Loaf](https://www.thefreshloaf.com/node/10414/trouble-converting-batter-firm-starter): Troubleshooting conversion from batter to firm sourdough starter
- [A Fruitful Weekend | The Fresh Loaf](https://www.thefreshloaf.com/node/10389/fruitful-weekend): Exploring Hamelman's Detmolder method with 90% rye and Vermont sourdough
- [Stephanie's Sourdough Blog | The Fresh Loaf](https://www.thefreshloaf.com/node/10341/stephanie039s-sourdough-blog): Beginner's sourdough starter troubleshooting journey by Stephanie Brim
- [Oat Starter only | The Fresh Loaf](https://www.thefreshloaf.com/node/1039/oat-starter-only): Mini Oven's oat flour starter experiment with orange juice
- [I've created a monster! | The Fresh Loaf](https://www.thefreshloaf.com/node/10273/i039ve-created-monster): Vermont Sourdough starter overflow from miscalculated feeding schedule

## Artisan Bread Recipes & Bakes

- [Cherry Pecan Pain au Levain | The Fresh Loaf](https://www.thefreshloaf.com/node/10313/cherry-pecan-pain-au-levain): Cherry pecan pain au levain inspired by Dan Leader's Bread Alone Bakery
- [40% Rye with Caraway to accompany Chicken Soup with Ginger & Dill | The Fresh Loaf](https://www.thefreshloaf.com/node/10390/40-rye-caraway-accompany-chicken-soup-ginger-amp-dill): 40% rye caraway bread using revived starter with Hamelman technique
- [Facebook Group Bake - French Baguettes - 2/2 to 2/8/2009 | The Fresh Loaf](https://www.thefreshloaf.com/node/10546/facebook-group-bake-french-baguettes-22-282009): Community baguette bake event featuring Anis Bouabsa method recipes
- [Sourdough Kaiser Rolls: Photo | The Fresh Loaf](https://www.thefreshloaf.com/node/10288/sourdough-kaiser-rolls-photo): First-time sourdough kaiser rolls from Northwest Sourdough recipe
- [I Made Pita! | The Fresh Loaf](https://www.thefreshloaf.com/node/10124/i-made-pita): First pita bread success using Beatrice Ojakangas whole wheat recipe
- [scones | The Fresh Loaf](https://www.thefreshloaf.com/node/103/scones): Sweet and savory scone recipes with variations for parties or teatime

## Baking Troubleshooting & Support

- [Burnt bread--stone problem? | The Fresh Loaf](https://www.thefreshloaf.com/node/10442/burnt-breadstone-problem): Troubleshooting over-browning crust issues with baking stone placement
- [How do I convert bread machine recipe? | The Fresh Loaf](https://www.thefreshloaf.com/node/1056/how-do-i-convert-bread-machine-recipe): Converting bread machine recipes for Bosch mixer use with mixing tips
- [Milk in Bread | The Fresh Loaf](https://www.thefreshloaf.com/node/10364/milk-bread): Safety questions about Peter Reinhart's room temperature milk fermentation
- [SAF red label instant yeast | The Fresh Loaf](https://www.thefreshloaf.com/node/10398/saf-red-label-instant-yeast): Finding SAF instant yeast in Berkeley Bay Area vs Red Star alternatives
